title: Implementation
description: Validates the Executor output artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. An implementation record captures the candidate commit produced by the executor, the files it changed, the number of iteration rounds, the self-check outcome, and the focused-test summary. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this implementation fulfills.

candidate_sha.description: Git SHA of the candidate commit produced by the executor.

base_sha.description: Git SHA of the base commit the candidate was built on top of.

changed_files.description: List of file paths changed between base_sha and candidate_sha.

commit_message.description: Commit message attached to the candidate commit.

rounds.description: Number of self-correction rounds the executor performed before emitting this candidate.

self_check_passed.description: Whether the executor's internal self-check passed for the candidate.

focused_tests.description: Summary of the focused (scoped) test run performed by the executor.

run.description: Whether the focused test suite was actually executed.

passed.description: Whether the focused test suite passed.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the focused test result.
